dedupe_keys.name: trafic annuel entrant par station du reseau ferre

description: Trafic annuel entrant par station du réseau ferré is a series of datasets listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RATP. Ce jeu de données détaille le trafic des entrants directs sur le réseau ferré RATP en 2018. Les « entrants directs » sont exclusivement les voyageurs provenant de la voie publique ou du réseau SNCF entrant sur le réseau de transport RATP en validant un titre de transport valide. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Trafic, Fréquentation, Voyageurs, Métro, RER, Transports en commun. The portal shows 369 records. The portal shows 2023-02-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
